title: B1 fix (origin-via-origin_domain) has zero automated pin — build_entity_url untested, handler wiring untestable by current suite
detail: The round-2 fix for the round-1 blocker (X-Forwarded-Host token exfiltration) is new code with no regression pin: reverting the handler to canonical_origin would fail no test. The pure helper (domain selection + fallback) is trivially unit-testable.
recommended_fix: Add email_client_test cases pinning build_entity_url (uses given domain, falls back to righttenantry.ie on ""), so the exfil guard's core mechanism fails a test if bypassed.

title: Fan-out bound's 1-hour window value unpinned — only the count (3) is tested, unlike the N21 10-minute cooldown pin
evidence:
Test: "  // Sends 1–3 win; send 4 hits the cross-vacancy hourly bound.
  let assert [v1, v2, v3, v4] = vacancies
  claim(v1) |> should.equal(1)
  claim(v2) |> should.equal(1)
  claim(v3) |> should.equal(1)
  claim(v4) |> should.equal(0)" — all four claims are immediate; no test stamps sends older than the window. SQL: "      AND d2.last_link_sent_at > now() - interval '1 hour'".
detail: The bound's count is pinned but its 1-hour window value is not — a typo'd interval would pass. Round 2 pinned the analogous 10-minute cooldown value (cooldown_window_is_ten_minutes_test) but not this window.
recommended_fix: Extend fan_out_bound_end_to_end_test (or add a case) stamping one send at now() - interval '61 minutes' and asserting the bound lifts, mirroring the cooldown-window test.

title: Empty-fields no-wipe guard pinned on the save path only — handle_continue_link's [] -> skip-upsample branch untested
detail: Round-1 fix applied the empty-fields guard to both save and continue-link, but only the save half has a regression pin. Testable without a real send by pre-stamping the cooldown, as the existing cooldown test does.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test: seed draft, pre-stamp last_link_sent_at, POST continue-link with empty fields, assert 200/sent:false and the stored fields still contain the original answers.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (save/token-mint/resume/strip/erasure-tombstone/expiry/cascade, token scoping + uniform 200/404, cap/fan-out/cooldown bounds, CSRF/public/body-size arms all integration- or unit-pinned; new pins verified against the SQL/handlers they claim to pin). P1 ≈93% (16/17; origin-via-origin_domain unpinned, plus two P2 partials). Overall ≈90%. Live Resend sends remain manual-E2E per accepted round-1 N27 precedent.
recommended_fix: Raise P1 toward 100%: unit-pin email_client.build_entity_url, pin the fan-out 1-hour window value, and add the continue-link empty-fields no-wipe integration test.
